facts.fact: ADIAC says state-owned Congo Telecom carries Congo's side of the regional Central African Backbone, which connects the country to Gabon since 2018 and to the Central African Republic since 2022.
ADIAC says the Central African Backbone link to Cameroon is still being carried out.
ADIAC says Congo was re-elected to the board of the African Telecommunications Union for Central Africa at the end of July 2026 in Abuja.
